why: Chris, 10 October 2026: "each course must get its own level names". Nine levels each for the new courses (lib/practice.php PracticeRanks(): safety Witness to Case Closer, socialmedia Scroller to Attention Master, sql9 Visitor to Reserve Warden, pascal9 Trainee to Mission Director); the frame grows bronze to silver to gold as for the 2026-10-01 emblems. PracticeRankEmblem() draws the old emblem until the file exists. Do not run while the GPU is busy with videos (Chris). Added the same day: clubweb (Blank Page to Webmaster) and the CAT sets Chris approved - cattheory (Gr 10-12 and the pilot), catword, catexcel, catpowerpoint, cathtml, catdb. Tuck-shop tycoon (tuckshop, Grade 7) added 10 October 2026: Shop Helper to Tuck-shop Tycoon. Inside the machine (machine, Grade 7) added 10 October 2026: Dust Speck to Master Engineer. Fact or fake (factfake, Grade 8) added 11 October 2026: Scroller to Truth Keeper.
style: A glossy 3D game rank emblem, smooth shiny enamel and metal, soft studio light, like a reward in a mobile game. The whole emblem centred on a plain pure white background with space all around it. No text, no letters, no numbers, no words, no logos anywhere.
